verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route that any MCP-compatible client can use to search indexes. Through it, agents can create indexes, add documents, configure settings and ranking rules, and run searches via natural-language prompts. An independent probe also confirms the official MCP documentation. Missing for 10: evidence that analytics (queries, clicks, conversions) is exposed through the MCP/tool surface, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.
